briefing.headline: Nvidia's board brought Jensen Huang back as CEO, and chip stocks then rebounded on Black Friday, though Nvidia itself lagged.

points.text: Jensen Huang returned as Nvidia CEO after the board voted unanimously on Monday. Nvidia's stock closed up 31% that day.
points.label: reported

points.text: Nvidia's stock still fell nearly 28% in November and 21% for 2026, even after a strong week.
points.label: reported

points.text: Chip stocks led a Black Friday rally. Taiwan Semiconductor ADR rose nearly 3% and SanDisk rose over 6%. Nvidia missed out.
points.label: reported

points.text: A Bloomberg report says Nvidia Blackwell chips turned up in a Shanghai data center linked to a person in the CEO scandal. Nvidia fell about 2% on the news.
points.label: reported

points.text: Governance experts call the board's decision a mistake and expect long scrutiny. Congress investigations may follow.
points.label: opinion
